description: Source code defining the DecimalType class and companion object in Apache Spark, representing fixed-precision decimal data types with methods for type comparison, creation, and validation.

classes.name: DecimalType
classes.description: Represents fixed-precision decimal data type with methods for comparison, size estimation, and type compatibility.

methods.name: typeName
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the decimal type with precision and scale.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the DecimalType instance.

methods.name: sql
methods.description: Returns the SQL string representation of the decimal type.

methods.name: isWiderThan
methods.description: Checks if this DecimalType can safely cast other DataType without losing information.

methods.name: isTighterThan
methods.description: Checks if this DecimalType can be safely cast into another DataType without losing information.

methods.name: defaultSize
methods.description: Estimates the storage size in bytes for this DecimalType.

methods.name: simpleString
methods.description: Returns a simple string representation of the decimal type.

methods.name: asNullable
methods.description: Returns a nullable version of this DecimalType.
